analysis.rationale: R1 信号重释后维持 noise_gaussian_YCrCb:2。依据: (1) 重跑 run_full_analysis 与 R0 一致 (NO_COMPRESSION bb=0.9992/unique_G=256; BLUR_UNLIKELY slope_ratio=0.9937<1.08; sigma=14.46 GAUSSIAN_YCrCb); (2) 边界检验: residual wavelet sigma=18.53 触发的 sev3 上边界 WEAK (sigma diff 37%), 与 R0 sev1 WEAK (32%) 夹逼, 仅 sev2 MATCH; (3) 被忽略的色度误归因假设 RGB:2+saturate_strengthen_HSV:3 WEAK (variance_ratio diff 904%, 指纹 std 66.1 vs 31.1, rgb_ratio 1.1355 vs 1.6253, cross_ch 0.1059 vs 0.2926) → 否决; (4) 纯 YCrCb:2 模拟的 §B 指纹与目标逐项一致 (std 31.1=31.1, ch_stds [30.9,23.0,37.3] vs [30.9,22.9,37.3], rgb_ratio 1.6240 vs 1.6253, cross_ch 0.2940 vs 0.2926), 且 3/3 对 support verify_signals 全 MATCH。噪声步骤按 SKILL 规则永不 LIKELY → UNCERTAIN。
